case: Custom PostgreSQL enum labels through raw CSV export, parse and typed import
contract: BookieE raw CSV output quotes embedded double quotes and multiline fields, retains backslashes and formula-shaped text, and uses a collision-free explicit SQL NULL marker.
CSV parsing and schema-aware typed import preserve every label and SQL NULL as separate values.
The restored rows match exact expected text, native pg_typeof(status), and UTF-8 hex bytes for each non-NULL enum label.

focused_test.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml --package tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration enum_contract::value_contract_custom_enum_csv_round_trip_preserves_quotes_lines_and_backslashes -- --include-ignored --exact --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml --package tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other PostgreSQL enum session/configuration combinations and other CSV delimiters or application-specific imports remain open in B3.
